digest.component_or_area: reconcile-bridge GitHub Actions reconciler and Jira comment synchronization
propositions: Six markerless reconciler echo bodies exist across three tickets; each body has two Jira copies—one preexisting survivor and one rollout-created duplicate—causing concentrated retained payload

Preparation phase must build immutable manifest, implement GET-only dry-run Jira cleanup tool bound by digest, create local Git history rewriter preserving survivors and removing only enumerated echoes, and document coordinated quiet-window runbook without external mutation

Jira cleanup tool must delete exactly six manifest-enumerated rollout-created IDs in canary order, verify byte/identity equivalence of survivors and non-targets post-deletion, and enable resumable append-only logging with no blind retry on ambiguous responses

Local Git rewriter must remove only manifest-enumerated COMMENT events and snapshot material while preserving six survivor events, all unrelated paths, bridge bindings, signatures, topology, and authorship ledgers; final epoch must be updated and all commit/merge topology verified

Complete off-repository bundle backup and independent restore must succeed before any candidate; disposable exact-lease rollback/forward and stale-epoch refusal must be proven without pushing or updating authoritative refs

Coordinated execution requires GitHub Actions reconcile-bridge.yml disablement verification, frozen Git/Jira inputs, exact-six Jira cleanup, two unchanged production-equivalent dry-run observations while workflow disabled, verified Git candidate publication with exact old-tip lease, persistent clone replacement, and re-enable only after non-resurrection checks
